title: Will the next big discovery using LLM's solve Fusion Energy?
author: DivingForGold
snippet: Or, is it too much of a hardware problem, rather than just software ? You can bet the folks over at Sandia, Fermi, PPPL, LANL, LLNL, ORNL, INL, Brookhaven, etc are all working feverishly with LLM's. No doubt a Noble prize would be possible.
